clips.title: The story
paras: In Astranaar, Sentinel Tara Thenysil watches Ashenvale and the southern road into Stonetalon. She tracks military movements and keeps scouts watching neighboring lands, with special attention on allied forces moving south.

At her post in Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil helps guard Ashenvale as hostility grows. Night elf lands across the region face steady encroachment, so outposts must stay in contact. While much of the garrison defends the forest road, Thenysil sends Alliance volunteers beyond Ashenvale to support distant allies.

Sentinel Thenysil shares a close friendship and military bond with Kaela Shadowspear, an operative sent south into the Stonetalon Mountains. When she learns Kaela was sent with an eccentric gnome mage, Thenysil takes the strange pairing as a sign of serious trouble in the peaks. Concerned for her comrade, she sends capable travelers south with support and asks them to report on the mission.
